target.title: test(ci): cover more owner script routes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`test/scripts/test-projects.test.ts` already had a real-repo owner-route expectation table for changed-mode script routing, but several script-to-test mappings that already exist in `scripts/test-projects.test-support.mjs` were not asserted there. That left CI without a direct regression if those owner routes drifted or were accidentally removed from the real-repo expectation surface.

## Why This Change Was Made

This extends the real-repo route expectation table with additional script-owner mappings that are already present in the support map:

- `scripts/lib/vitest-local-scheduling.mjs` → `test/scripts/vitest-local-scheduling.test.ts`
- `scripts/qa-e2e.ts` → `test/scripts/qa-e2e.test.ts`
- `scripts/qa-lab-up.ts` → `test/scripts/qa-lab-up.test.ts`
- `scripts/qa-coverage-report.ts` / `scripts/qa-parity-report.ts` → `test/scripts/qa-report-cli.test.ts`
- `scripts/qa/render-maturity-docs.ts` → `test/scripts/render-maturity-docs.test.ts`
- `scripts/watch-node.mjs` → `test/scripts/watch-node.test.ts`

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. This only strengthens CI coverage around changed-mode script routing so helper and owner-script edits continue to select the right focused tests.

## Evidence

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/test-projects.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /home/0668000995/10288592/git-hub/test/openclaw

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  184 passed (184)
   Start at  19:23:06
   Duration  17.35s (transform 1.27s, setup 412ms, import 469ms, tests 16.14s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 27.94s
```

- Verified the owner-route expectation for `scripts/lib/ios-version.ts` remains aligned with the current main contract while the new owner-route coverage for the other mapped scripts still passes
- Added changed-mode route assertions for:
  - `scripts/lib/vitest-local-scheduling.mjs`
  - `scripts/qa-e2e.ts`
  - `scripts/qa-lab-up.ts`
  - `scripts/qa-coverage-report.ts`
  - `scripts/qa-parity-report.ts`
  - `scripts/qa/render-maturity-docs.ts`
  - `scripts/watch-node.mjs`
